blind.description: A low wooden market display bin divided into four separate compartments holding bulk goods. From left to right (as seen in front view): pale yellow grain or rice, bright yellow-orange spice or flour with an embedded wooden scoop, dark reddish-purple beans or seeds, and dark olive-green dried herbs or grain. The frame is constructed of warm reddish-brown wood with corner posts acting as feet. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures, free of holes, shards, or floating geometry.
blind.from_above: A rectangular divided wooden tray oriented horizontally, split into four square sections displaying four distinct colored and textured contents (cream, golden-orange with a small scoop, bumpy dark maroon, and olive green).
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around knee height, roughly 1/3 to 1/4 the height of the figure), and roughly 4.5 to 5 feet long.
